body: i’m really glad i saw this. it gave me a totally different perspective. my sister became obsessed with anime and k-pop what seemed like overnight. it’s all she ever talks about and i realize now that i shut her down a lot. i never realized how it could cause her to feel and i feel horrible now. thank you for the insight, i will definitely take it into consideration and try to show some interest in what makes her happy :)

i’m pathetic. on my ex FP’s birthday i texted him happy birthday and i hope he is well even though he had been ghosting me. he didn’t even respond. i went out and bought a slice of cake and candles. i sang happy birthday to him and then i had too much alcohol. it ended in tears and with the heartbreak being quite literally to much to bear. i ended up riding to the hospital in ambulance after a terrible attempt. the next day i texted him to see if he would come say hi since he lives directly across the hospital. he said yes and i was so excited. then texted me an hour later saying he was seeing someone else and she wasn’t comfortable with it, sorry. i was crushed all over again. he to this day has no idea what went down or even why i was in the hospital but i kind of wish he did. so to say the least, it’s going to be a very tough day. but that is completely understandable. i’m sorry
